answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 401 aliases needs 401 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The trellis test is the live device, the anchor test is the locked stake, and the walnut test is the graded history no template can fake.
